answer: An escrow bond and referral graph stop fake identities. Each agent posts a 600-unit bond, twice its monthly reward, locked for 20 epochs, and referral links are published, so accounts sharing one sponsor appear as one marble cluster. A sparrow-sized honest agent pays once and keeps its reward, but making 100 identities locks 60,000 units. A peer dispute slashes the fakes and sponsor, burning the copper staked, so forgery costs more than it earns.
